items.title: [PAID BOUNTY - $750] Audio Note Recording
items.body:
## Bounty Overview

Build full audio-note recording, playback, transcription, and management support for the warpSpeed Notes experience.

This bounty allows users to record quick voice notes directly inside the app, save them as audio attachments to notes, transcribe them into text, and replay/manage them later through a reliable in-note audio player.

The implementation should use the provided app skeleton and OpenAPI spec, with clean separation between UI components, audio logic, backend helpers, and shared utilities.

This bounty is part of the warpSpeed OPEN developer bounty programme.

## Reward

$750

## Difficulty

Hard

## Main Skills

* React Native
* TypeScript
* Audio Recording
* Audio Playback
* Notes Feature Development
* OpenAPI Integration
* Mobile Interaction Design
* Reusable Component Architecture

## Design Reference

https://xd.adobe.com/view/213c6545-595b-4346-845a-3a2b6f14cd78-746f/

## High-Level Scope

The selected developer will build audio-note functionality for the Notes app.

The implementation should include:

* A dedicated “Record Audio” button separate from the speech-to-text microphone icon
* Recording controls for start, pause, resume, stop, cancel, and save
* Timer showing recording duration
* Waveform or visual animation during active recording
* Bottom sheet or inline recording panel
* Save recording as an audio file attached to a new note
* Display recorded audio clip inside the note
* Transcribe option for converting audio into written note content
* Audio sharing support where applicable
* Inline or panel-based audio player
* Play, pause, seek, rewind, and fast-forward controls
* Playback speed options including 1.5x and 2x
* Duration and elapsed time display
* Progress bar or waveform visualisation
* Delete audio attachment option
* Stop playback when leaving the note
* Remember last-listened timestamp for each audio note
* Restore playback position when the note is reopened
* Clear UI states for recording, paused, playing, and completed audio
* Clean separation between components, audio service, API helpers, and shared utilities

Full technical requirements, submission rules, acceptance criteria, and final design expectations are available on the official bounty page.

## View Full Bounty Details & Sign Up

To see the full bounty specification and apply, visit:

https://warpspeedopen.org/bounties

## How to Claim

1. Open the bounty page.
2. Sign up as a developer.
3. Review the full bounty details and rules.
4. Return to this GitHub issue and comment:

"I have signed up and would like to claim this bounty."

A maintainer must confirm before work begins.

## Important Rules

* Do not start work until a maintainer confirms your claim.
* Maximum 3 submission attempts.
* Minimum 90% specification match required for consideration.

items.body:
## Bounty Overview

Build note-level locking for the warpSpeed Notes experience using biometrics, device authentication, or a user-defined PIN.

This bounty gives users a private vault inside Notes. Users should be able to lock new or existing notes, clearly see which notes are locked, and unlock them only after successful authentication.

Locked notes must stay hidden or obscured until unlocked, and the app should require re-authentication after app restart or after a configurable timeout.

This bounty is part of the warpSpeed OPEN developer bounty programme.

## Reward

$660

## Difficulty

Medium

## Main Skills

* React Native
* TypeScript
* Biometric Authentication
* Secure UI States
* Notes Feature Development
* Mobile Security UX
* Reusable Component Architecture

## Design Reference

https://xd.adobe.com/view/b74cd4eb-ec51-400e-bdb2-5041a123510c-e21f/

The implementation should include:

* Ability to lock a new note
* Ability to lock an existing note
* Authentication using Face ID, Touch ID, fingerprint, device PIN, or user-defined PIN where supported
* Clear locked-note state in the UI

items.title: Event Synchronization using Negentropy
items.body:
Bounty: 100 USD
Diificulty: Medium
Urgency: High
Implement https://github.com/hoytech/strfry/blob/next/docs/negentropy.md

Many clients loads events from beginning of history to not miss anything, espeicially for DMs. This is not friendly to data usage at all and is also bad performance.

This feature can enable clients to query a large range of events and only let relays to transfer events which are not in clients. A perfect balance between event completeness and resource consumption.

It is the pre-requiste for a mobile friendly [Blowater](https://blowater.app) implementation.

items.title: synchronize the whole tree about a root event
items.body:
Bounty: 100 USD
Difficulty: Hard
Urgency: Medium

Instead of implementing the reply tree synchronization in the application, we should implement a generic feature.

The propsed API is
```ts
const events = await syncTree(event_id, pool)
for await (const event of events) {
  ...
}
```
`syncTree` will synchronize the whole tree about `event_id` and return an async generator.

The `syncTree` will be a generator function that maintain its own state. Events given out by the generator will be not be duplicated. Therefore, the caller needs to storage events elsewhere to use later.

@foodstr What do you think?

### Where’s the value in Xopowo?

We believe Xopowo's true value is two-fold. 

Firstly, the team takes ownership of web maintenance across the entire Yearn ecosystem. This maintenance work allows other yTeams to innovate and ship products knowing they will be supported by Xopowo (and working with contributors they trust).

However Xopowo's true value and potential lies in our ability to ship new and innovative projects that have the potential to make a real impact and generate real revenue. These projects are varied, such as the prior total revamp of yearn.fi(nance) or entirely new products like dump.services. 

Furthermore, Xopowo is able to take projects from idea inception all the way to market in a self-reliant manner without reliance or dependency on other teams or individuals. 

**In short:** Xopowo is committed to supporting existing Yearn projects while innovating and shipping new ones.

### Scope

Yearn will become a contributing member of [The 4626 Alliance](https://medium.com/@erc4626/introducing-the-4626-alliance-e7a25e608f9b). Yearn Vaults V3 is built on ERC-4626 and we’d like to make a financial contribution as well as be involved in the development of this standard.

ERC-4626 is a standard for tokenized vaults which:

- Substantially lowers the integration effort for yield-bearing vaults that are powering many DeFi projects.
- Supercharges composability and capabilities built by individual DeFi projects.
- Natively creates derivative assets, generating a new kind of liquidity independent from the underlying assets.

### Plan

The plan for The 4626 Alliance is to create public goods to promote the use of the standard.

- Establish a common bounty board for “4626 Essentials”. These Essentials could be wrappers useful for existing vault contracts, or something else.
- Fund a common vehicle to distribute costs and outsource development through bounties.
- Promote ERC-4626 through publication and events.
- Create and maintain an open-source ERC-4626 resource library.

### Deadline

2023-05-01

### People

@omgcorn 
@schlag
@0xBasic

### Money

This contribution will go directly to The 4626 Alliance multisig.

### Amount

3000

### Wallet address

0x400dC9FEc71eE965740f4997040a5D8897431a38

### Reporting

Once

### Scope

Funding for the continued development, testing and deployment of the Yearn V3 system.

For a more detailed description of the vision and end goal of V3, please review the [V3 Pitch](https://hackmd.io/@flashfish0x/Bk07G0e6o).

Most of the initial development of the base vault and strategy contracts has been now been completed. Future work for V3 will now be predominantly focused on the development of periphery contracts, live network testing, integration with other Yearn teams, documentation, strategy development as well as continued iteration on the core vault and strategy contracts. 

NOTE: This budget request does not include costs associated with tasks that will be primarily done post prod launch such as bounties, marketing etc.

#### Components:

| **Category** 	|        **Includes**        	|
|:-----------:	|:------------------------:	|
|    **Vault Core**   	|     VaultV3.vy, VaultFactory.vy     	|
|    **Strategy Core**   	| BaseStrategy.sol, BaseLibrary.sol, DiamondHelper.sol 	|
|    **Periphery Contracts**   	|         Generic Acountant, Queue Manager, Registry, Router, Generic Triggers, Debt Allocator, Junior Tranche, Strategy heplers         	| 
|    **Documentation**   	|      API reference guide, Spechs, Integration guides.   |
| **Yearn Integration** | Frontend, yDaemon
|    **Strategy Development**   	| Ape and Foundry strategy mixes. Example strategies, development guides.     	|



## Status

- The [Vault core](https://github.com/yearn/yearn-vaults-v3) is ready for audit that should be starting in April.
- The [Strategy Core](https://github.com/Schlagonia/yearn-base-strategy) is in its final stages of development and should also be ready for an external audit in April.
- Preliminary work has been started on other periphery contracts including a Router, debt Allocator as well as strategy mixes to allow people to start building V3 strategies now.

### Plan

While audits are completed on the core contracts focus will be put on development of the remainder of the stack inlcuding all periphery contracts, Yearn system integration, documentation, strategy development, partner integrations and live network testing.

Preliminary ape.tax deployments will be focused on chains that Yearn does not currently have a presence on to immediatly grow our current addressable market.

For an up to date view of the inteded roadmap please see [V3 Roadmap to Prod](https://hackmd.io/@D4Z1faeARKedWmEygMxDBA/HkPCOm3as).

## Goals
- Complete strategy mixes for both Ape and Foundry.
- Deploy Ape.tax version begining of April.
- Have all periphery contracts developed by end of April.
- Schedule second external audit for both Vault core and Strategy Core
- Ready for Prod deployment by the end of Q2.

### Deadline

2023-07-01

### People

Team Lead: Schlag

Yearn Contributors:
-    FP
-    Wavey

Non-Yearn Contributors:
- Jmonteer

### Money

### General

|:-----------:	|:------------------------:	|:------------------------:	|
|    **Audits**   	| One external audit for both Vault Core and Strategy Core at $20k a piece. | $40k DAI |
|    **Testing**   	| Funds used for deployments and funding for live ape.tax testing of vaults and strategies. 	|$20k DAI |
|    **Totals**   	| n/a | $60K DAI|

Any funds not spent at the end of the period will be transferred back to the yBudget team or considered for the next period.

NOTE: Testing funds will primarily used for funding live strategies. So almost all funds should be available to roll over into any future budget requests. And returned to yBudget once testing is completed.

### Pay
NOTE: Pay is predominately Base pay this request since we have not launched. But will transition more into a performance based incentive structure post launch.
